title: Cyber and Operational Resilience Framework for All Local Banks and Financial Institutions
summary: The Central Bank of Kuwait's Cyber and Operational Resilience Framework (CORF, version 1.0, first released 3 December 2025) replaces the 2020 Cybersecurity Framework for local banks and financial institutions. Its emerging technologies section (7.1.4) requires regulated entities to start adopting quantum-resistant cryptographic algorithms, periodically assess cryptographic practices, develop a quantum readiness strategy with migration timelines and milestones, and test quantum-resistant algorithms before deployment.
